newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Intel Octobers become active.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Intel Octobers become active.

text.p: Intel Corp options were active on the American Stock Exchange as investors began to get out of September positions and establish October ones.
"Some of the Octobers are starting to trade," one trader said. "It looks like interest is picking up there for sure."

While the Intel September 80 call and corresponding put, with more than 3,200 contracts traded each, were the most active Intel options, the October 80, 85 and 90 calls were active, as was the October 75 put.
In afternoon trading, Intel shares were ahead 1-1/4 at 81-7/8 on nearly 3.7 million shares.
A couple January 1997 Intel options also were busy, the 90 call, with 1,060 contracts traded and the 65 put, with 2,100.
Elsewhere, two January 1997 options on PepsiCo Inc were active as an investor put on a spread several times.
The January 1997 27-1/2 call and put each traded 1,750 contracts. PepsiCo shares were up 1/4 at 28-1/2.
Chase Manhattan Corp had the most active option around. The Chase September 75 call traded 5,560 contracts, nearly all its open interest.
With the stock ahead 1-7/8 at 75-3/4, the September 75 call rose 5/8 to two.
Options on several networking stocks drew interest as the stocks as a group move higher amid the broad market rally, traders said.

Among them, Newbridge Networks Corp options were active on the Pacific Stock Exchange and Ascend Communications Inc options were active on the Chicago Board Options Exchange and the American Stock Exchange and less so on the Pacific and Philadelphia exchanges.
Newbridge shares were up 2-1/2 at 63-5/8 and Ascend gained 2-1/8 to 53-1/4.
The technology-heavy Nasdaq composite index was up 15.11 points, or 1.35 percent, at 1,140.77 by 1400 CDT (1900 GMT).
